manifest.candidate_rationale: the basic cohort's only arm: first-party production, games, age, one lag and last-seen features; the selection policy (baseline / candidate / bounded blend) is chosen per position, horizon and quantity on closed inner folds

forecast_cutoff.rule: features observed through the feature season; a year-j label trains only when feature_season + j <= last complete season
forecast_cutoff.information_through: end of the 2025 NFL season including postseason

manifest.exposure_definition: games: weeks with a weekly stat row in scope
manifest.event: appeared: >= 1 stat-row game in the season
manifest.composition: e_points_year{j} = p_appear_year{j} x e_points_year{j}_given_appear on the same event and rows; points and games are exactly 0 when absent
manifest.population: every 2025 row of the basic cohort (a row exists for season t if the player appeared in season t or t-1 (a whole missed season after an active one is a zero-games row); two straight absent seasons leave the cohort)

source_validation.cleaning: the dropped placeholder rows and unattributed stat lines are a disclosed cleaning exception, not proof of source completeness; they are kept in dropped_rows.csv so the cleaning can be replayed

manifest.intervals: none exported; bootstrap intervals are sampling uncertainty conditional on the fitted models (players resampled from fixed fits); not model, selection or season uncertainty, and not a forecast interval

meaning.supported: closed history sufficient to evaluate; not validation
meaning.bootstrap: bootstrap intervals are sampling uncertainty conditional on the fitted models (players resampled from fixed fits); not model, selection or season uncertainty, and not a forecast interval
meaning.brier: a better Brier score alone is not a calibration proof; read the expected calibration error and the reliability slope/intercept (1 and 0 when calibrated) beside it

manifest.inputs_note: the basic cohort does not read the Engine B training file; its inputs are the two snapshots

cohort.production_scope: ALL games with a stat line (REG + POST), the DG-024 production definition

feature_notes.seasons_played: seasons OBSERVED since the cohort start (2005); left-censored, not full career length
feature_notes.position_rule: modal stat-line position must be QB/RB/WR/TE; a two-way player whose stat lines say CB is excluded by this rule
